name: Agent Control Plane MCP Server
description: Implementation specification and template for an agent control-plane MCP server; no launchable server is packaged.

capabilities: Check proposed agent actions against JSON policy rules.
Record agent action events with input and output hashes.
Create approval requests for high-risk actions.
operational.approval_boundary: Safe for policy checks and audit writes; requires human approval before executing high-risk operational actions or changing policy.

limitations: Specification, prompts, and examples only; no launchable MCP transport is packaged.
usability.quickstart: Review TOOL.md as an implementation contract; do not register this package as an MCP server.
